summary: Iteration 4 frontend-only verification of duplicate-id fix and Undo/Redo. Of 13 declared review-request flows, 9 PASS and 1 CRITICAL FAIL: drag-undo does NOT restore original position because ImageBox.jsx never calls commit() inside startDrag/startResize (it imports commit but never invokes it). Resize-undo affected by the same root cause. RESULTS: (1) PASS Unique IDs after duplicate: dblclick + 3 clicks on duplicate-button -> 4 placements with 4 unique data-placement-id values (verified: p_mq14a2kj_8z3ysz, p_mq14a308_27gwsf, p_mq14a36o_hi75io, p_mq14a3d5_q7rcv1). (2) PASS Individual selection of duplicates: clicking each of the 4 placements toggles selection-editor for that placement. (3) PASS Independent movement: dragging the 4th placement +100x/+48y moved only the 4th (positions of placements 1-3 unchanged before/after; only target id moved from 827,460 -> 929,508). (4) PASS Undo/Redo buttons exist with proper initial state: undo disabled=true, redo disabled=true initially; after first placement undo becomes enabled. (5) PASS Ctrl+Z 3 times after placing same image 3 times: placements 3->2->1->0, thumbnails remain at 1 (only placements undone, image loads kept). (6) PASS Ctrl+Shift+Z: restored 1 placement after the 3 undos. PASS Ctrl+Y: also works as redo (restored second placement). (7) PASS Undo of layout: 4 images + layout-2x2 -> 4 placements; undo-button -> 0 placements; redo-button -> 4 placements. (8) FAIL CRITICAL Undo of drag: drag moves placement correctly from (600,166) to (681,243) but Ctrl+Z REMOVES ALL PLACEMENTS instead of restoring original position. Root cause: ImageBox.jsx line 15 imports commit but never invokes it inside startDrag (lines 22-51) or startResize (lines 53-114). Therefore the drag operation is NEVER snapshotted to history, and Ctrl+Z jumps back to the previous committed state (which here was the empty/undo-of-layout snapshot). (9) PASS Undo of deletion: place image, Delete, Ctrl+Z restores placement (validated in nested run). Note: layout-ine and multi-page page-count regression NOT re-tested in this run because the drag-undo failure (#8) wiped the placements mid-script; iteration_3 already validated those flows.

ui_bugs.issue: commit() is imported but NEVER invoked inside startDrag or startResize. Drag/resize operations produce NO history snapshot, so Ctrl+Z after a drag jumps over the move and undoes the previous operation instead. Review request explicitly required commit() on first mousemove (single snapshot per drag).

integration_issues.issue: Drag is not committed to history. Repro: load image, place it (1 placement), drag with mouse 80px, press Ctrl+Z -> placement disappears (count goes to 0) instead of returning to pre-drag coordinates.
Same root cause as drag-then-undo: startResize in ImageBox.jsx does not call commit() either. Not exercised in this run but inferred from code review.

action_items: URGENT: In /app/frontend/src/components/ImageBox.jsx, add commit() on the FIRST mousemove of both startDrag and startResize (use a local flag like let committed=false; inside onMove do `if (!committed) { committed=true; commit(); }`). This will make drag/resize a single undo step as the review request specifies and will fix the failing flow (#8).
After fix, re-test drag-undo and resize-undo: position should be restored exactly to pre-drag/resize coordinates with a single Ctrl+Z.
critical_code_review_comments: ImageBox.jsx imports `commit` from usePrinter() but never calls it. Either invoke it on first mousemove during drag/resize, or remove the import. This is the root cause of the failing drag-undo behavior.
PrinterContext.placeImage already calls commit() at the top, so placing/duplicating/deleting all snapshot correctly — only drag/resize is missing.
Canvas.jsx onDropToPage clamp `Math.max(0, Math.min(70, xPct-15))` still hardcodes wPct=30 (carried over from iter 1/2/3 — not yet addressed).
History stack uses array spreads on every commit which is O(n) — acceptable at HISTORY_LIMIT=50 but worth noting.
Sonner toaster uses richColors so contrast is fine in this iteration (improved from iter 3 nit).

success_rate.frontend: Approximately 90% — 9/10 actively exercised flows passed; 1 critical drag-undo flow failed. Remaining flows (INE/layout-ine, multi-page page-count regression, export pdf/png) were validated in iteration_3 and not regressed in this code (commit is properly called in applyLayout, placeImage, removePlacement, clearAll, clearCanvas, removeImage, applyIneLayout, resetPlacement).

seed_data_creation: PNG data URLs generated at runtime via canvas.toBlob (200x200 solid color squares) and injected via DataTransfer onto data-testid="file-input". No persistence.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix needed in ImageBox.jsx: call commit() once at the start of drag/resize movement (on first mousemove, not on every frame). Pattern: let committed=false inside startDrag; in onMove first line: if (!committed) { committed=true; commit(); }. Same for startResize. After fix, re-run: (a) place image, drag 80px, Ctrl+Z -> position restored to original; (b) place image, resize with se-handle, Ctrl+Z -> size restored. Also worth verifying that Ctrl+Z after rapid multi-drag still produces single-step undo (one drag = one history entry). All other undo/redo flows are working correctly: placement, duplicate, delete, layout apply, INE layout, clearAll/clearCanvas are all properly committed via PrinterContext.
rca of the issue: PROBLEM: Drag-then-Ctrl+Z removes the placement entirely instead of restoring its original (pre-drag) position. REPRO: 1) Upload 1 image, 2) Double-click thumbnail to place (1 placement on canvas), 3) Apply layout-2x2 with 4 images then undo+redo (to populate history past), 4) Drag any placement ~80px in any direction (movement is reflected on screen), 5) Press Escape, then Ctrl+Z -> ALL placements disappear (state jumps back to pre-layout snapshot) instead of just reverting the drag. ROOT CAUSE: /app/frontend/src/components/ImageBox.jsx imports `commit` on line 15 from usePrinter() context but NEVER invokes it inside startDrag (lines 22-51) nor startResize (lines 53-114). Because no history snapshot is taken at the start of a drag/resize, the undo stack still points to the previous committed state. When the user presses Ctrl+Z, the snapshot that gets popped is the one BEFORE the drag-target was even placed, so the placement disappears. MITIGATION: Wrap the first call to updatePlacement inside the drag's onMove with a one-shot commit() — exactly as the review request promises. Code sketch: `const onMove = (ev) => { if (!committed) { committed = true; commit(); } /* existing logic */ }; let committed = false;` declared in the closure of startDrag (and equivalently in startResize). This produces a single history step per gesture (not per frame), which matches the user-expectation that Ctrl+Z restores the position BEFORE the drag began.
